title: Gaming PC: AMD 9800X3D, RTX 5080 OC, B850 Mobo, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 850W Gold PSU $3549 + Delivery ($0 SYD C&C) @ UMKLOGIX
body:

[CheapBrah] 3.5k and only 32gb ram and 1TB SSD. Times are tough.

like $3.5k??? and you still need a monitor kbd mouse
does it even have an o/s?
no? i'm just gon go touch some grass
[Frackingiscool] Nothing against store, more against the current garbage fire of the tech market.
I gave up on a return desktop gaming and bought a mini PC that plays everything I want on my TV with a controller. New games thankfully aren't tickling my pickle so I don't need a discrete GPU and can get lost in the world of modded fallouts/skyrim/no man's sky/7dtd/Ark/etc and emulated games I've been missing on XSX/PS5.
Once the AI bubble pops and prices look normal again I'll reassess. But for now, unjustifiable.
[JarrodRebecchie] In B.A.I. times, what would be the usual cost of this much silicon and metal?
[Skinnerr] I'm so glad I quit gaming 10 years ago, saved thousands.
[supersabroso] It's true but this would be only $2.5k if they settled for a AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT graphics card instead for only about 12% drop in performance on games. Being smart with your money goes a long way.
[riitiir] I was just going to do the same comparison. So many people will drop $1500 upwards on a phone and not have the same thought process.
3.5k for a phone is absurd.
[jace88] Whilst I haven't been following the Fold 8 Ultra deals, who pays full price for a Samsung phone at launch?… esp not on OzB
[G0dang] Damn. I am glad I bought before this shitshow.

[Ryuhayebusa] if your wanting path tracing games like cyberpunk, indiana jones,new doom or Alan wake 2, then a 5080 is one of the top cards for you, just depends on how much your willing to spend.
[Slay16] Thanks for the reply. That sounds like what I was looking for. Just not sure if I should buy now or wait for better deals or Black Friday (I know they mark up the price before hand though) as 3.5k is a lot of money! Much to think about…
[redcafej] My 2 cents? The AI bubble is bursting, companies are limiting usage because it's so expensive. If you can wait why not?
[Slay16] @redcafej: I can definitely wait, however how long for I wonder? I will keep an eye out nonetheless. Frustrating times we are in unfortunately.
[iLikeSales] @Slay16: same i want to know this too, im trying to do 4k 60fps high on my tv in the living room and my pc currently is cooked. Current one cant even do 1440p120fps.
i7 13th gen, 3080 8GB, 64GB DDR5 4800hz (I think)
and if this 3.5k pc is a good price during the ai price increase - ill need to pull the trigger. Didnt they say RAM prices are going to double once again in 2027? We're cooked.
EDIT: Also what company do they ship with?
[lijy85] @iLikeSales: I'd just sell the 3080 and get a 9070xt. I run a i5-12400f with 9070xt and it's tip top for 60fps 4k.

It's also hard to know if we are at the peak with prices as there are plans for more data centres in Melbourne and this article corroborates what you're saying https://www.techspot.com/news/112934-ram-prices-expected-ris… with prices. Honestly, I feel sick thinking about spending this much money on something that's been jacked up in price thanks to AI
